group.passage: Today, most matches light only when they are struck on the side of their box. Early matches were very different. In 1826, an English chemist named John Walker made the first friction match by accident, when a stick covered in chemicals caught fire as he scraped it. Soon afterward, makers began putting white phosphorus in the match head, so a match could be lit on almost any rough surface. These handy matches, however, came at a terrible cost to the people who made them. Most match factory workers were women and children, and they often worked 12 to 16 hours a day. Breathing the fumes of white phosphorus could cause a disease called “phossy jaw.” The jawbone slowly died, the teeth decayed, and some workers lost part of their jaw. About 11 percent of those exposed to the fumes got the disease, usually around five years after they started the job. In 1888, the women at a large match factory in London went on strike. Besides facing the danger, they were poorly paid, and they could be fined for small things such as talking or having dirty feet. When the company fired one worker, 1,400 women walked out, and within a few days the whole factory had stopped. The strike ended when the company agreed to take the worker back and to stop cutting their pay. Afterward, the women formed their own union, and the next year, gas and dock workers in London went on strike as well. A safer kind of match already existed. In a safety match, the phosphorus is not in the head but on the strip on the side of the box, so the match cannot light unless the two touch. In 1901, the London factory said it would stop using white phosphorus. In 1906, a group of countries signed an agreement in Bern, Switzerland, to ban the making, importing, and selling of matches that contain it.

translation_zh.text:
今天，大多數火柴只有在盒子側邊劃才點得著。早期的火柴可大不相同。1826 年，一位名叫約翰‧沃克的英國藥劑師意外做出了第一根摩擦火柴：他刮一根沾滿化學物質的小棍子時，它突然著了火。不久之後，製造商開始在火柴頭裡加入白磷，於是火柴在幾乎任何粗糙的表面上都劃得著。然而，這種方便的火柴卻讓製造它的人付出了可怕的代價。
火柴工廠的工人大多是婦女和兒童，她們常常一天工作 12 到 16 小時。吸入白磷的煙會引起一種叫做「磷毒性顎骨壞死」的病。顎骨會慢慢壞死，牙齒蛀壞，有些工人甚至失去部分顎骨。接觸這種煙的人大約有百分之 11 會得病，通常是在開始工作大約五年之後。
1888 年，倫敦一家大型火柴工廠的女工發動罷工。除了要面對危險之外，她們的工資很低，還可能因為講話或腳髒之類的小事被罰錢。公司開除了一名工人後，1,400 名女工集體離開工作崗位，幾天之內整個工廠就停擺了。罷工在公司同意讓那名工人復職、並不再扣她們的薪水後結束。之後，這些女工成立了自己的工會；第二年，倫敦的煤氣工人和碼頭工人也發動了罷工。
其實，一種比較安全的火柴早就有了。安全火柴的磷不在火柴頭上，而在盒子側邊的長條上，所以兩者沒有接觸，火柴就點不著。1901 年，那家倫敦工廠宣布將停用白磷。1906 年，一些國家在瑞士伯恩簽署協定，禁止製造、進口和販賣含有白磷的火柴。
